title: Ta an bad ar an tir. Taim in mo shagart.
html_source: “The boat is on the land. I am a priest.” (Irish). May have been taken from O'Growney’s Simple Lessons in Irish. With corrected accent marks: Tá an bád ar an tír. Táim i mo shagart
